primaryClaim: The B3 predictive conclusions are DERIVED FROM A LOW-POWER 19-motor cohort. B4 will show that the underpowered inconclusiveness of every motor-equal M3 contrast is a stable property of the sample (not of a seed or an outlier), that the adverse M2-over-M3 result is robust to reasonable perturbations, and that M4 and M7 are at best weakly identified on this cohort.
primaryFalsifier: Any B4 cell that produces a CONCLUSIVE, seed-stable, perturbation-robust M3 contrast on the motor-equal aggregation would refute the claim that the cohort is uniformly underpowered. A demonstration that M4 or M7 is strongly identified (tight, non-collapsing bootstrap) would refute the weak-identification expectation.

predictions.statement: Under correct specification the simple models (M0,M1,M2,M3,M5) recover their true parameters within tolerance and win their own competitions in > 50% of simulations, confirming the B3 pipeline is not systematically biased.
predictions.falsifier: A generating model that fails to win its own competition majority, or median parameter bias exceeding tolerance.

predictions.statement: Under >= 2 of 3 misspecified generators, a lognormal-like model out-scores the two-timescale mixture under NLPD, i.e. the B3 adverse pattern is a feature of heavy-tailed dwell shape rather than of one assumed mechanism.
predictions.falsifier: M2 beating M3 in <= 1 of the 3 misspecified generators would make the adverse result GENERATOR-SPECIFIC.

predictions.statement: The duration competitors carry no varied prior; M8's rank is stable across its +/-1 grid-step bandwidth neighbourhood.
predictions.falsifier: M8 rank changing across the neighbour bandwidths.

predictions.statement: All 8 primary M3 contrasts remain INCONCLUSIVE on motor-equal across all 5 seeds and both replicate counts under both rules; the B3 inconclusiveness is a sample property, not a seed artifact.
predictions.falsifier: Any seed producing a conclusive motor-equal M3 contrast verdict.

predictions.statement: Naive inclusion of right-censored dwells measurably changes the fitted scales and scores (censoring is load-bearing), and the frozen exclusion is correctly applied.
predictions.falsifier: Treatment (b) being indistinguishable from the frozen exclusion, which would mean censoring is not respected.

predictions.statement: The NLPD leaderboard head and the M2-vs-M3 direction are unchanged across analysisStartIndex {3400,3500,3600} and under the drop-longest/shortest outlier sensitivity.
predictions.falsifier: A leaderboard-head or M2-vs-M3 direction change under any start index or the outlier sensitivity.

predictions.statement: The frozen eligibility rule reproduces [1..8] exactly; the [0..8] and state-0 sensitivities are reported with cohort-dependence labelled, and state 0 stays UNDERPOWERED_SENSITIVITY_ONLY.
predictions.falsifier: The recomputed eligible set differing from [1..8].

predictions.statement: No single holdout-motor removal flips any primary M3 contrast verdict or changes the leaderboard leader; leave-one-study-out and leave-one-condition-out are NOT_RUN (single study, no separable condition).
predictions.falsifier: One motor whose removal flips a contrast verdict or changes the leader.

predictions.statement: The M2-vs-M3 NLPD direction and the leaderboard leader survive 0.02 s interval jitter in >= 95% of replicates; the adverse result is not within measurement quantization noise.
predictions.falsifier: > 5% of jittered replicates flipping the M2-vs-M3 direction or the leader.

predictions.statement: M4 is at best weakly identified on 19 holdout / limited training motors: the training-motor refit bootstrap is expected to show a non-trivial collapse fraction and/or a wide log10(lambda_3) interval, so U2, U3 or U4 fires even though the point estimate was DISTINCT in B3.
predictions.falsifier: All of U1-U4 clearing with tight, non-collapsing bootstrap intervals, which would make M4 strongly identified.

predictions.statement: Despite tau being interior and LRT-supported over M1 in B3, tau is informed only by between-motor contrasts, so the profile is expected to be flat (U2 logspan large) and/or the bootstrap collapse fraction non-trivial (U4), i.e. the dispersion is weakly determined.
predictions.falsifier: A sharp tau profile (small logspan) and a near-zero bootstrap collapse fraction, which would make tau well-identified.

predictions.statement: The stability ledger will show the adverse M2>M3 direction and the universal inconclusiveness as STABLE across perturbations, with the CRPS-vs-NLPD rule disagreement also stable, and M4/M7 identifiability the main SPECIFICATION-DEPENDENT items.
predictions.falsifier: The adverse result or the inconclusiveness proving UNSTABLE under a documented perturbation.

licensed: A mapped validity domain for the B3 predictive conclusions (which are stable, which specification-dependent).
A defensible statement that the adverse M2-over-M3 result is robust on this cohort.
Honest UNIDENTIFIED/weak-identification verdicts for M4 and M7.
forbidden: Promoting any predictive model to molecular mechanism.
Moving any parity level above P3.
Reading an underpowered inconclusive contrast as equivalence.
Treating state 0 as anything but a labelled underpowered sensitivity cohort.
